sourceInformation.plan: PLAN.md (written by claude-opus-5-5 at max effort); built at a smaller scope
sourceInformation.genre: On-rails action-adventure shooter (rail movement, stop-and-scan first-person shooting, persona switching, boss fights)
sourceInformation.perspective: Third-person cinematic rail cameras while moving; first person while aiming
sourceInformation.tech: my-3D2dge v0.85.2 (2D engine plus its 3D module on three.js r182 and Rapier 0.19.3 from a CDN), plain JavaScript with a concatenating build script, AI Hub session client 1.4.0
sourceInformation.artDirection: The engine's native style: PS1-resolution picture, pixel-art rigs drawn on cards in 3D, Comic cel filter; stark snow white, black ink, saturated red; new hats, props, skis and guns
sourceInformation.animation: The engine's procedural E.Humanoid rigs and poses, extended with new hat styles; skis, the Sweep's kneel and first-person guns drawn with the 3D pen
sourceInformation.audio: All in code: chip-synth songs, SFX voices, a custom WebAudio laughter synth and Animalese-style gibberish voices; no audio files
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub Session Protocol v1, ghost mode: Echo Run downhill time trial with the other players as ghosts; solo it races your own best run
sourceInformation.testing: Headless Node suites (sim and systems checks, a scripted bot playthrough of the whole demo), a content validator, headless Chromium (boot, the whole demo in the real page, AI Hub harness with 2 and 4 players, latency, loss and host-leave); screenshots only for visuals
sourceInformation.research: none beyond PLAN.md and the engine manual
sourceInformation.environment: Claude Code CLI (headless); Linux; browser unknown

testingFeedback: About 11 issues: Room 7's door could not be walked through, a coat for the ice gate was never findable, a skill press reset the charge fuse, Target 00's results never showed, junction clicks were ignored, the hub reported no progress, the gun view went black under the filter, the terrain camera sat underground, the lift camera lost the hero, and two stale-state leaks.
Five were critical or game breaking: the Room 7 door, the missing coat for the serac gate, the charge fuse reset, the hub never reporting progress, and the black aim view.
The scripted playthrough: a bot that plays the real sim from a new game to the credits, and the same run in the real page with game.advance.
Re-running the engine's own kit tests after a three-line engine patch: they passed and told me nothing about the game.
engineFeedback: The 3D module's fixed cameras, rigs drawn as cards and Comic cel filter gave a Killer7 look almost for free, and the whole sim runs headless under Node with game.advance.
Yes: the first-person overlay pass goes black when the cel filter is on (WebGL path), fog distances are engine units not metres, and game.go() before game.start() has finished only warns.
The rail walker with its camera director, aim, scan and Warm Spot combat, the story beat runner, a controller-first canvas UI kit with glyph prompts, and the laughter and Animalese synths.
Learning the 3D module's units and conventions (pen frames, camera yaw and pitch, fog, terrain extents) from a header comment alone.

Eight new hat styles (beanie, ushanka, felt, hardhat, pillbox, racehelmet, beret, goggles) for the Seven; PlayStation button symbols as the default; and in an AI Hub session Options is ignored while Create is held. Each is marked S7 PATCH.
Make the first-person overlay pass work under any filter, so a gun view model needs no workaround.
promptFeedback: The plan gave a real design with numbers, a flow with timings and a tests chapter, and TASK.md's hard list (attract, dev sliders, hub, 10-foot UI) was unambiguous.
The plan is sized for a far bigger effort than the stated medium effort, and it never says what to cut first.
Fitting a plan for nine areas, three bosses and forty source files into one working, finished vertical slice with no stubs.
Mark every plan feature must, should or could, and say how much of the plan a lower effort level is expected to deliver.

aiHub.name: SKILLER7
aiHub.description: Seven killers share one body on a snowbound mountain. Ride the rails, stop, scan for the laughing invisible Whiteouts and shoot the Warm Spot. Race the Black Run in Echo Run with your friends as ghosts.
aiHub.controls: W/✕ run · S/○ about-face · RMB/L2 aim · LMB/R2 fire · Space/L1 scan · E/□ skill · Tab/R1 coats
